Subject: Recap: call this morning — SOC 2 scope, retention trade-offs, DPA next steps

Thanks again for taking time this morning — quick written recap so we have a shared decision log and clear owners. High-level: RiskBound is evaluating Redwood for chat/embeddings in a customer-facing product where auditability and retention controls are material. Key asks from the call: SOC 2 alignment, longer audit-log retention (12–24 mo), contractual language in the DPA about log access and third-party pen tests / evidence.

Summary of pain / goals
- Need SOC 2 controls mapped to our data flows (auth, multitenancy isolation, log integrity).
- Retention: default session/token TTL is too short for their compliance; they prefer 12 months of immutable audit logs with 24-month archive capability.
- Evidence: RiskBound wants examples of prior pen-test summaries + artifact list we can provide for procurement (redaction acceptable).
- Legal: they prefer limited DPA edits but want stronger language around log delivery timelines and support for eDiscovery requests.

Agreed next steps and owners (short form)
1) Redwood to produce a scoped SOC 2 to-DDQ mapping for the RiskBound use case — owner: Ben Carter — deliver by 2026-08-28.
2) Draft DPA clause proposals (log access SLA, retention exceptions) — owner: Jordan Blake & Legal — initial draft shared 2026-08-26.
3) Evidence bundle: sanitized pen-test summary + example audit-log export sample + list of artifacts we can share — owner: Camila Reyes — package uploaded by 2026-08-25.
4) Technical follow-up on retention architecture (immutable audit logs, replayability, region residency) — owner: Ben Carter — technical note by 2026-08-27.
5) Schedule final procurement review call (RiskBound legal + Redwood) — tentative: 2026-08-31 11:00 AM PT.

Nate — quick technical answers inline to your question and to capture the follow-ups Camila listed.

- Do audit logs include API-level ids and model identifiers? Yes. Current audit logs include: timestamp, request_id, user_id (if provided by the caller), model_id + variant tag, region, response status, and token counts. We do not persist full PII in logs by default; payloads are truncated per our redaction policy.

- Retention model & costs: we offer tiered retention.
  * 90 days (default, included)
  * 12 months (recommended for customers with moderate compliance needs) — includes hot searchability and export API (estimated incremental cost: $0.015 / GB-month)
  * 24 months (cold archive) — cheaper storage but retrieval latency for forensic requests: estimated incremental cost: $0.006 / GB-month.

I'll prepare the technical note with concrete examples, an export sample (JSON schema), and a short cost model for 12 vs 24 months — target 2026-08-27 as Camila noted.

One implementation note: for immutable logs we rely on append-only storage with object immutability flags and checksums; we can provide checksums and signed timestamps for audit purposes. If you need HSM-backed timestamping, that's an additional integration we can scope.
